title: Setup Android SDK fails - sdkmanager cannot find deprecated 'tools' package
signature: warning failed to find package tools sdkmanager exit code 1 setup android sdk|Configuration

failed_jobs.name: CXX_Unit_Tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Setup Android SDK step fails: sdkmanager exits with code 1 after 'Failed to find package tools'

failed_jobs.name: CXX_Func_Tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Setup Android SDK step fails: sdkmanager exits with code 1 after 'Failed to find package tools'

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_android
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check fails because upstream jobs failed

key_errors:
Warning: Failed to find package 'tools'
Error: The process '/opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/20.0/bin/sdkmanager' failed with exit code 1
root_cause: The 'Setup Android SDK' step invokes android-actions/setup-android with packages: 'tools platform-tools'. The legacy 'tools' package has been removed from the Android SDK repository (dl.google.com), so sdkmanager cannot resolve it and exits with code 1, failing the step in both CXX_Unit_Tests and CXX_Func_Tests. This is a pre-existing CI configuration issue in the releases/2026/4 branch's android.yml workflow; it is unrelated to the PR's own changes (docs-only). Master's android.yml (commit d7055662, '[GGUF FE] Runtime extension mechanism for adding architectures') already fixed this by requesting only 'platform-tools' with a comment noting the legacy tools package was removed.
reproduction_steps: Run 'sdkmanager tools' with a recent Android SDK cmdline-tools version (20.0) against the current SDK repository; it returns 'Warning: Failed to find package tools' and exits non-zero, matching the CI log.
recommended_actions: Edit .github/workflows/android.yml on releases/2026/4 (or in this sync PR) to change 'packages: tools platform-tools' to 'packages: platform-tools' for the Setup Android SDK step(s), matching master's fix in commit d7055662.
Re-run the merge-queue check once the workflow file is corrected.
prevention_strategies: When syncing master into a release branch, diff CI workflow files (.github/workflows/*.yml) explicitly for config drift, since docs-only PR scopes can silently miss CI-relevant fixes already applied on master.
historical_context: No prior CI Doctor MQ pattern recorded for this specific 'tools' package removal; a related but distinct pattern (7eb75d0b5dca4a63) covers a transient 'Connection reset' failure during Android SDK Build-Tools installation, which is a different (Network) root cause.
